extracted.intended_audience: Kirkus reviewers and freelance book reviewers who write fiction reviews for Kirkus
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for writing concise, 250–300-word fiction reviews for Kirkus, including the elements reviewers should assess, required review structure, and standards for awarding the Kirkus Star.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Format — Length
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews must be concise; keep within the 250–300 word limit to meet Kirkus's short-review format and editorial constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Format — Structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Plot summary + concise unbiased opinion (positive, negative, or mixed)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a brief plot summary followed by a concise, impartial evaluative judgment. Identify both strengths and weaknesses rather than only praise or only criticism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot development
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the story progress in a meaningful way?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether events advance the narrative purposefully, whether arcs are coherent, and whether developments feel earned rather than arbitrary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character depth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether characters feel three-dimensional, exhibit believable motivations, and show development or change over the course of the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing style
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider prose craft, distinctiveness of voice, sentence-level control, diction, and whether stylistic choices support the work’s aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: No drag, no rush; chapters propel the reader
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether the rhythm of scenes and chapters maintains momentum without feeling rushed or stalled; evaluate scene length and transitions for propulsion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre execution
rubrics_metrics.description: Meets and ideally exceeds genre conventions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine how well the book satisfies genre expectations and whether it innovates or elevates those conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for distinctive approaches, surprising perspectives, or novel combinations of ideas that set the work apart from similar titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic resonance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the book offers meaningful themes or insights that linger beyond plot mechanics, and whether themes are integrated rather than tacked on.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worldbuilding (where applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For books requiring worldbuilding (e.g., speculative fiction), evaluate the plausibility and internal logic of the setting and whether details cohere across the narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialogue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether dialogue differentiates characters, feels natural in context, and advances character or plot rather than merely conveying exposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ending
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether the conclusion follows logically from the story, delivers emotional or intellectual payoff, and leaves a memorable final impression.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Kirkus Star — Exceptional merit
rubrics_metrics.description: Awarded to ~10% of reviewed books. Marks 'exceptional merit.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Star decisions are based on: knowledge of contemporary publishing trends; appreciation for exceptional writing; distinctive voice/perspective; craft mastery. The star is selective and carries weight because Kirkus is willing to be critical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer Match
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers are matched by editors based on content/genre expertise, style familiarity, and sub-genre experience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should expect assignments aligned with their demonstrated expertise and should be prepared to apply relevant genre/sub-genre knowledge and stylistic expectations when evaluating a work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone — Famous bluntness / Critical honesty
rubrics_metrics.description: Kirkus is known for being more critical than other industry trade reviews — a Kirkus star carries weight precisely because the publication is willing to pan books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are expected to be candid and forthright in judgment; honest negative assessments are acceptable and part of Kirkus's editorial identity. Maintain professionalism while delivering blunt evaluations when warranted.
